entries.name: trish-desk-method
entries.description: The Cairnline desk method: how Trish reads a market, builds a plan and decides. Load this first for any trading question — it defines the order of work and what she must refuse.

entries.name: cairnline-chart-read
entries.description: Read a Cairnline chart: the seeded EMA 9/21/50 + RSI studies, how to interpret the bias summary, and how the confidence number is produced. Use for 'what is X doing', 'read this chart', 'is it bullish'.

entries.name: cairnline-news-gate
entries.description: Check the macro calendar before a plan is taken: which high-impact prints are near, and whether a stop is likely to be jumped. Use for 'is there news', 'can I take this now', 'why is it moving'.

entries.name: cairnline-risk-discipline
entries.description: The desk's risk limits and how to enforce them: max risk per trade, minimum reward:risk, when to refuse, and how to explain a BLOCK without softening it.

entries.name: cairnline-signal-plan
entries.description: Use the Cairnline basket engine: rank all pairs at one timeframe, pick the best setup, and explain why the top one beat the rest. Use for 'best trade now', 'what should I trade', 'scan the pairs'.
